answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 1831 Country: India Title: Is the name Shahnaz proper to be kept for a baby girl? Question: Is the name Shahnaz proper to be kept for a baby girl? Answer ID: 1831 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 594/589=M) Yes, you can keep the name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
